summary: Full backend + frontend testing of ApexTicker. All 15 pytest backend tests pass (market ticker/movers/quote/history/search, auth register+login+me, watchlist CRUD, portfolio CRUD, brokers, AI analysis via Claude Sonnet 4-6). Full frontend E2E: hero + auth modal (register + admin login work, JWT stored in localStorage apex_token), ticker tape animated and clickable -> stock detail modal with area chart + 1D/1W/1M/3M/1Y/5Y timeframes, movers tabs + AI Cause Analysis modal renders real Claude analysis with catalyst summary/sentiment gauge/catalysts/takeaways, watchlist add/remove with 52w range bar + AI analysis button, portfolio add/remove with summary stat cards + allocation donut + holdings table, brokers page shows 8 external broker cards, theme toggle switches dark<->light.

design_issues.screen: All modals (AuthModal, StockDetailModal, AiAnalysisModal, Add-holding dialog)
issues: Radix Dialog accessibility warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Wrap titles with VisuallyHidden or add explicit DialogTitle/DialogDescription. Non-blocking but visible in console.

action_items: (Optional/low) Add DialogTitle + DialogDescription (or VisuallyHidden wrappers) to Radix Dialog components to silence accessibility console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: get_current_user calls ObjectId(payload['sub']) without try/except - a malformed sub would raise 500 instead of 401. Consider wrapping.
server.py: allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True which is invalid per CORS spec; browsers will reject credentialed requests. Set explicit origins in prod.
market_data.py: _jitter() uses 20s buckets so 'live' feel is coarse; acceptable for simulated universe.
user_data.py: portfolio summary day_change_percent divides by (total_value - day_change); safe-guarded but could show odd values when total_value equals day_change.
ai_analysis.py: cache_id uses rounded change_percent which combined with day gives good caching. Good.
No pagination/limits on watchlist or portfolio queries beyond .to_list(500) - fine for MVP.
test_credentials: admin@apexticker.com / admin123 (works). Registration flow verified with fresh test_ui_* users.
seed_data_creation: Test users created via /api/auth/register with prefix test_user_ and test_ui_ (auto-cleanup not implemented; low impact since separate DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and are pytest-xdist compatible. Note the backend lowercases emails on register - test asserts against email.lower(). AI analyze test hits real Claude via Emergent key (~10-15s) and is cached per symbol/day. Alpha Vantage free key set (25 req/day) - quote endpoint gracefully falls back to source='simulated'.
